audit_metadata.evaluation_set: Locked Held-Out Test Set (N = 448 across 7 distinct generator/camera cohorts)

data_leakage_certification.validation_set_used_for_tuning: Locked VAL split (N=248: 124 Real, 124 Fake) was strictly used for model selection, temperature calibration (T=1.0859), and decision threshold selection (tau=0.57).

Google_Gemini_Imagen3.training_status: Fine-Tuned in Phase 15/16 (13 Train, 4 Val, 8 Locked Test)
Google_Gemini_Imagen3.forensic_commentary: 100% of decisive test samples are detected as FAKE. The 2 inconclusive cases were caused by branch discrepancy (spatial CNN detected photorealistic skin pores and scored low, but frequency DCT branch flagged subtle spectral grid cues, activating the empirical safety gate). Note: N=8 is a small test cohort; universal Gemini detection cannot be claimed from this sample alone.

StyleGAN2.training_status: Seen during primary training (300 Train, 60 Val, 60 Locked Test)
StyleGAN2.forensic_commentary: Virtually near-perfect detection. Both spatial artifact cues and frequency-domain checkerboard spectral anomalies strongly signal synthetic generation.

StableDiffusion_v1.5.training_status: Seen during multi-generator training (140 Train, 30 Val, 30 Locked Test)
StableDiffusion_v1.5.forensic_commentary: 96.15% decisive recall. Attention floor (0.25) prevents the spatial branch from completely dominating the decision, allowing spectral diffusion noise signatures to be captured.

InsightFace_Swap.training_status: Seen during multi-generator training (140 Train, 30 Val, 30 Locked Test)
InsightFace_Swap.forensic_commentary: 95.65% decisive recall. Blending boundaries around the swapped face mask provide clear cues in both spatial and frequency domains.

StableDiffusion_Inpainting.synthesis_type: Selective Inpainting Diffusion (Completely Excluded from Training)
StableDiffusion_Inpainting.training_status: Zero-shot held-out test cohort (0 Train, 0 Val, 200 Locked Test)
StableDiffusion_Inpainting.forensic_commentary: True out-of-distribution generator test. Selective local inpainting leaves authentic background and hair context intact, causing frequent branch disagreement. The 3-way policy abstains on 55.0% of cases rather than making blind false-real mistakes; on decisive cases, it detects 77.78% of manipulated images.

FFHQ_Real.training_status: Seen during multi-generator training (490 Train, 84 Val, 60 Locked Test)
FFHQ_Real.forensic_commentary: Zero false positives across all 60 test images (100% binary specificity, 0% FPR). Decisive cases achieve 100% specificity.

IMDB_WIKI.synthesis_type: Historical / Archival Photography with Film Grain & Legacy Compression
IMDB_WIKI.training_status: Seen during multi-generator training (100 Train, 40 Val, 60 Locked Test)
IMDB_WIKI.forensic_commentary: Key forensic vulnerability. Archival film grain, legacy JPEG compression blocks, and scanning noise emulate the high-frequency spectral artifacts of synthetic generators, causing false positives and high inconclusive rates.
